key_differentials: 腹腔内实质脏器（肝、脾）破裂出血
神经源性休克（脊髓损伤）
key_clues: FAST 腹腔阴性而血流动力学不稳定，提示出血来源在腹膜后/骨盆
骨盆X线耻骨联合分离 >2.5 cm、右骶髂关节增宽
会阴/阴囊瘀斑、双下肢不等长外旋
乳酸升高、碱缺失加重，对晶体液仅短暂反应
guideline_refs: ATLS Student Course Manual (American College of Surgeons) - Shock / Abdominal and Pelvic Trauma
WSES classification and guidelines for pelvic trauma (Coccolini et al., World J Emerg Surg 2017)
European guideline on management of major bleeding and coagulopathy following trauma, 6th ed (Rossaint et al., Crit Care 2023)
ETC-01.final_diagnosis: 不稳定型骨盆环骨折（前后挤压型 APC-III，右骶髂关节分离）伴腹膜后出血、失血性休克（Unstable pelvic ring fracture, APC-III, with retroperitoneal hemorrhage and hemorrhagic shock）

key_clues: 低血压合并右侧呼吸音消失、叩诊鼓音、气管左偏、颈静脉怒张
床旁超声右侧肺滑动征消失、见肺点
张力性气胸是临床诊断，不应等待胸片
guideline_refs: ATLS Student Course Manual (American College of Surgeons) - Thoracic Trauma
BTS guideline for pleural disease (Roberts et al., Thorax 2023) - 仅作气胸处理参考
ETC-02.final_diagnosis: 右侧张力性气胸伴右侧多发肋骨骨折（Right tension pneumothorax with multiple right rib fractures）

key_differentials: 失血性休克（胸壁/肋间血管或腹腔损伤）
key_clues: 伤口位于'危险区'（胸骨旁、乳头连线以内）
Beck 三联征：低血压、颈静脉怒张、心音遥远；可见奇脉
FAST 心包剑突下切面见心包积液及右室舒张期塌陷
双肺呼吸音存在、无气管偏移，可区分张力性气胸
guideline_refs: ATLS Student Course Manual (American College of Surgeons) - Thoracic Trauma
EAST practice management guideline: emergency department thoracotomy (Seamon et al., J Trauma Acute Care Surg 2015)
ETC-03.final_diagnosis: 胸部穿透伤致右心室破裂、急性心包填塞（Penetrating cardiac injury of the right ventricle with acute pericardial tamponade）

key_differentials: 胸骨骨折/肋骨骨折所致胸痛
急性主动脉夹层（非创伤性）
key_clues: 高速减速伤机制本身即需筛查主动脉损伤
胸片纵隔增宽、主动脉结模糊、左侧胸膜帽、气管右移
双上肢血压差、肩胛间区疼痛
CTA 是确诊手段，主动脉峡部（左锁骨下动脉开口远端）最常见
guideline_refs: ATLS Student Course Manual (American College of Surgeons) - Thoracic Trauma
Society for Vascular Surgery clinical practice guidelines for endovascular repair of traumatic thoracic aortic injury (Lee et al., J Vasc Surg 2011)
EAST guideline: blunt thoracic aortic injury (Fox et al., J Trauma Acute Care Surg 2015)
ETC-04.final_diagnosis: 钝性胸主动脉损伤（主动脉峡部假性动脉瘤，SVS III 级）（Blunt thoracic aortic injury at the isthmus with pseudoaneurysm, SVS grade III）

ETC-05.topic: 主动脉夹层（以创伤为表现的非创伤性急症）
key_differentials: 单纯机械性跌倒致头外伤
颅内出血（创伤性或高血压性）
key_clues: 跌倒前突发'撕裂样'胸背痛（需主动追问）
双上肢血压差 >20 mmHg、右桡动脉搏动减弱
新出现主动脉瓣舒张期杂音
头颅CT阴性不能解释神志改变和低血压；心超见升主动脉内膜片及心包积液
D-二聚体显著升高
guideline_refs: 2022 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Aortic Disease (Isselbacher et al., Circulation 2022)
2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of peripheral arterial and aortic diseases (Mazzolai et al., Eur Heart J 2024)
ATLS Student Course Manual - Primary survey / Head trauma
ETC-05.final_diagnosis: 急性 Stanford A 型主动脉夹层（累及右头臂干）致晕厥后跌倒，伴心包积血（Acute Stanford type A aortic dissection with innominate artery involvement and hemopericardium, presenting as syncope with fall）

key_clues: 3天前篮球比赛中左下胸被膝盖撞击（需主动追问外伤史）
Kehr 征（左肩放射痛）
晕厥+心动过速+血红蛋白下降
FAST 脾周及盆腔积液；CT 见脾包膜下血肿破裂
近期'感冒'伴咽痛（可追问，传染性单核细胞增多症应除外）
guideline_refs: WSES guidelines: Splenic trauma (Coccolini et al., World J Emerg Surg 2017)
AAST Organ Injury Scale - Spleen (2018 revision, Kozar et al., J Trauma Acute Care Surg 2018)
ATLS Student Course Manual - Abdominal and Pelvic Trauma
ETC-06.final_diagnosis: 迟发性脾破裂（包膜下血肿破裂，AAST IV 级）伴腹腔积血、失血性休克（Delayed splenic rupture from a ruptured subcapsular hematoma, AAST grade IV, with hemoperitoneum and hemorrhagic shock）

key_clues: '昏迷—清醒—再昏迷'的中间清醒期
右侧瞳孔散大、对光反射迟钝，左侧肢体肌力下降
Cushing 反应：血压升高、心率减慢
头颅CT双凸透镜形高密度影，不跨越颅缝
guideline_refs: Guidelines for the Management of Severe Traumatic Brain Injury, 4th ed (Brain Trauma Foundation, Carney et al., Neurosurgery 2017)
Surgical management of acute epidural hematomas (Bullock et al., Neurosurgery 2006)
ATLS Student Course Manual - Head Trauma
ETC-07.final_diagnosis: 急性硬膜外血肿（右颞，伴颞骨骨折、脑中线移位）（Acute right temporal epidural hematoma with temporal bone fracture and midline shift）

key_differentials: 感染（尿路感染/肺炎）致谵妄
key_clues: 长期口服利伐沙班（房颤）——需主动核对用药
轻微头部外伤后迟发意识改变
右侧肢体轻偏瘫+言语含糊
头颅CT新月形高密度影跨越颅缝
末次服药时间决定逆转策略（安得塞奈或凝血酶原复合物）
guideline_refs: Guidelines for the Management of Severe Traumatic Brain Injury, 4th ed (Brain Trauma Foundation 2016)
European guideline on management of major bleeding and coagulopathy following trauma, 6th ed (Rossaint et al., Crit Care 2023) - 抗凝逆转
NICE NG232 Head injury: assessment and early management (2023) - 抗凝患者头外伤CT指征
ETC-08.final_diagnosis: 抗凝（利伐沙班）相关急性左侧硬膜下血肿伴中线移位（Rivaroxaban-associated acute left subdural hematoma with midline shift）

key_differentials: 急性动脉损伤/肢体缺血
脱水致肾前性氮质血症
key_clues: 长时间（>4小时）肢体受压、解除压迫后病情恶化
心电图 T 波高尖、QRS 增宽，血钾 7.2 mmol/L
CK 显著升高（>5000 U/L），尿呈酱油色、隐血阳性而镜下红细胞少
小腿张力高、被动牵拉痛、骨筋膜室压力升高
guideline_refs: Rhabdomyolysis and acute kidney injury (Bosch, Poch, Grau, N Engl J Med 2009)
Recommendations for the management of crush victims in mass disasters (Sever, Vanholder, Lameire, Nephrol Dial Transplant 2012)
ATLS Student Course Manual - Musculoskeletal Trauma
ETC-09.final_diagnosis: 挤压综合征：右下肢挤压伤所致横纹肌溶解、高钾血症（伴心电图改变）及急性肾损伤，合并右小腿骨筋膜室综合征（Crush syndrome with traumatic rhabdomyolysis, life-threatening hyperkalemia, acute kidney injury, and right leg compartment syndrome）

key_differentials: 隐匿性颅脑损伤（迟发血肿）
key_clues: 长骨骨折后 24–72 小时出现呼吸、神经、皮肤三联征
腋下、结膜、口腔黏膜瘀点
CT肺动脉造影无充盈缺损而有双肺弥漫磨玻璃影
头颅MRI DWI '星空征'；头颅CT阴性
血小板下降、贫血、眼底视网膜出血/渗出
guideline_refs: Gurd and Wilson criteria (Gurd AR, Wilson RI. J Bone Joint Surg Br 1974)
Fat embolism syndrome review (Kosova, Bergmark, Piazza, Circulation 2015)
ATLS Student Course Manual - Musculoskeletal Trauma
ETC-10.final_diagnosis: 脂肪栓塞综合征（股骨干骨折后，伴低氧血症、脑病及结膜/腋下瘀点）（Fat embolism syndrome after femoral shaft fracture with hypoxemia, encephalopathy and petechial rash）

key_differentials: 低血容量致肾前性少尿
key_clues: 24小时内晶体液 >10 L、大量输血
腹部高度膨隆紧张，少尿不随补液改善
气道峰压/平台压升高，PaCO2 升高
膀胱压（IAP）>20 mmHg 伴新发器官功能障碍
血红蛋白稳定、引流量不多，不支持再出血
guideline_refs: WSACS consensus definitions and clinical practice guidelines for intra-abdominal hypertension and abdominal compartment syndrome (Kirkpatrick et al., Intensive Care Med 2013)
European guideline on management of major bleeding and coagulopathy following trauma, 6th ed (Rossaint et al., Crit Care 2023) - 限制性晶体液复苏
ETC-11.final_diagnosis: 继发性腹腔间隔室综合征（大量液体复苏后，膀胱压 28 mmHg 伴少尿及通气障碍）（Secondary abdominal compartment syndrome after massive resuscitation）

ETC-12.topic: 老年髋部骨折合并隐匿问题
key_differentials: 机械性跌倒（绊倒、视力差）
体位性低血压/药物（降压药、镇静药）
短暂性脑缺血发作/卒中
病理性骨折（骨转移、骨髓瘤）
key_clues: 跌倒前无先兆'突然眼前发黑'——需追问跌倒经过
心率 38 次/分且不随疼痛加快
心电图 P 波与 QRS 完全分离（房室分离）、宽 QRS 逸搏
近两个月反复头晕、乏力、两次'差点摔倒'
老年髋部骨折必须问'为什么摔'
guideline_refs: 2018 ACC/AHA/HRS Guideline on the Evaluation and Management of Patients With Bradycardia and Cardiac Conduction Delay (Kusumoto et al., Circulation 2019)
2018 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of syncope (Brignole et al., Eur Heart J 2018)
NICE CG124 Hip fracture: management (updated 2023)
ETC-12.final_diagnosis: 左股骨颈骨折（Garden IV 型），跌倒原因为三度房室传导阻滞所致心源性晕厥（Left femoral neck fracture, Garden IV, caused by a fall due to syncope from complete heart block）
key_tests: 髋关节X线（骨盆正位+左髋侧位）

ETC-13.topic: 空腔脏器损伤（多发伤隐匿损伤）
key_differentials: 腰椎压缩骨折单纯疼痛
key_clues: 下腹部横行安全带勒痕（安全带征）
胸腰段 Chance 骨折与空腔脏器损伤高度相关
首次CT仅见少量无实质脏器损伤的游离液体、肠系膜条索影
腹痛进行性加重、发热、白细胞升高，复查CT出现游离气体
guideline_refs: EAST practice management guideline: evaluation and management of small bowel injury / blunt hollow viscus injury
WSES guidelines (Coccolini et al.) - 钝性腹部创伤非手术治疗中的空腔脏器损伤风险
ATLS Student Course Manual - Abdominal and Pelvic Trauma / Spine Trauma
ETC-13.final_diagnosis: 钝性小肠穿孔（近端空肠）伴肠系膜挫伤、安全带征，合并 L2 椎体 Chance 骨折（Blunt jejunal perforation with mesenteric contusion and seat-belt sign, associated with L2 Chance fracture）

ETC-14.topic: 颅脑/颈部外伤（钝性脑血管损伤）
key_differentials: 癫痫发作后 Todd 麻痹
key_clues: 安全带颈部勒痕+左侧颈部疼痛、左侧 Horner 综合征（瞳孔缩小、上睑下垂）
头颅CT伤后初次阴性，神经症状在中间间隔后出现
符合 Denver/扩展 Denver 筛查标准（颈部安全带征、锁骨骨折+颈部软组织损伤、不能用CT解释的局灶神经体征）
颈部CTA 显示颈内动脉管腔不规则狭窄、壁内血肿
guideline_refs: EAST practice management guideline: screening for blunt cerebrovascular injury (Bromberg et al., J Trauma 2010)
Western Trauma Association critical decisions: blunt cerebrovascular injury (Biffl et al., J Trauma Acute Care Surg 2020)
AHA/ASA Guidelines for the Early Management of Patients With Acute Ischemic Stroke (Powers et al., Stroke 2019)
ETC-14.final_diagnosis: 钝性左颈内动脉夹层（Biffl II 级，伴管腔狭窄）致左侧大脑中动脉区急性缺血性卒中（Blunt left internal carotid artery dissection, Biffl grade II, causing acute left MCA ischemic stroke）

ETC-15.topic: 膈肌破裂（多发伤隐匿损伤）
key_differentials: 膈肌膨升（先天性/陈旧性）
key_clues: 左胸片'气液平'或胃泡上移、左膈面轮廓消失，误判为血气胸
插入胃管后胃管头端位于左侧胸腔
左胸闻及肠鸣音
CT 见'领口征'、膈肌不连续、腹腔脏器疝入胸腔
盲目放置胸腔引流管可能损伤胃/结肠
guideline_refs: ATLS Student Course Manual - Thoracic Trauma (traumatic diaphragmatic injury)
EAST practice management guideline: diagnosis and management of diaphragmatic injuries (McDonald et al., J Trauma Acute Care Surg 2018)
ETC-15.final_diagnosis: 创伤性左侧膈肌破裂伴胃及结肠脾曲疝入胸腔（Traumatic left diaphragmatic rupture with intrathoracic herniation of the stomach and splenic flexure）
